cves.description: A vulnerability has been found in Panabit Smart Application Gateway TANGr7p10. This issue affects the function send_email_authcode of the file user.cgi of the component Email Auth Code Sender. Such manipulation of the argument Username leads to os command injection. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
cves.fix_suggestion:
📦 受影响组件：Panabit Smart Application Gateway
🛠️ 修复建议：
1. 确认受影响的版本范围（见上方 Affected Products）
2. 升级到厂商官方发布的最稳定安全版本
3. 检查官方安全公告获取补丁链接
4. 如无法立即升级，实施临时缓解措施：
   - 网络层：WAF 规则 / IPS 签名 / 零信任策略
   - 主机层：最小化暴露面 / 禁用危险功能 / 输入过滤
5. 修复后使用 NVD / 厂商 PoC 验证修复有效性

cves.description: cnpmcore 3.46.0 before 3.84.3 and 4.0.0 before 4.37.3 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to obtain upstream registry authTokens via the GET /-/registry endpoints lacking AdminAccess middleware. Attackers can request /-/registry or /-/registry/:id and replay the leaked authToken as a Bearer credential to enumerate, download, or publish packages upstream.
